solutions.title: Check all substrings
solutions.strategy: Try every even-length substring and validate its parenthesis balance.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are O(n^2) substrings and each validation can scan O(n) characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only counters and loop indexes are stored.

solutions.title: Stack boundaries
solutions.strategy: Keep indexes of unmatched opens plus the latest invalid close as a boundary.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character index is pushed and popped at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack can hold all opening indexes in a prefix.

solutions.title: Two-pass counters
solutions.strategy: Scan left-to-right and right-to-left so invalid excess closes and opens both reset the window.

timeComplexity.explanation: Two linear scans cover the string.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only open/close counters and the best length are stored.
